description:
JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on Research Scientist I/II with strong immunology training to join the Biology group and support small-molecule drug discovery programs at Iambic Therapeutics. The successful candidate will design and execute in vitro and ex vivo studies that generate high-quality data for target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, and development candidate selection. The candidate will collaborate closely with colleagues in biology, medicinal chemistry, DMPK, in vivo pharmacology, computational biology, machine learning, and compound management groups. This role is based at our San Diego headquarters.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and execute assays using disease-relevant immune cells and tissues, including primary human and/or pre-clinical immune cells, whole blood, cell lines, and tissue-derived systems, to measure potency, selectivity, target engagement, mechanism of action, and functional immune responses.

 - Run recurring compound-profiling assays and generate timely, reproducible data to support medicinal chemistry design-make-test-analyze cycles from hit-to-lead through lead optimization and development candidate selection.

 - Apply quantitative pharmacology and rigorous data-quality practices to analyze concentration-response relationships, assay performance, reproducibility, and biological relevance.

 - Maintain accurate electronic laboratory records, protocols, and data packages; communicate results, technical risks, and recommended next experiments at biology and project-team meetings.

 - Support in vivo immunology studies by contributing to experimental plans and readout selection, processing study samples, conducting ex vivo analyses, and interpreting exposure, PK/PD, biomarker, and efficacy data with in vivo pharmacology and DMPK colleagues.

 - Support assay transfer and external studies with CROs or collaborators by executing internal bridging work, reviewing protocols and data, and troubleshooting technical issues.

 - Contribute to laboratory operations, reagent and instrument qualification, method documentation, and a culture of scientific rigor, safety, collaboration, and timely execution.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - PhD in immunology or a related field, or another biological discipline with immunology-focused postdoctoral training, plus 0–4 years of relevant experience; or MS with 7+ years / BS with 9+ years of relevant experience.

 - Strong knowledge of innate and/or adaptive immunology, immune-cell signaling, and disease-relevant mechanisms, with the ability to translate biological questions into well-controlled experiments.

 - Strong hands-on experience designing and executing in vitro and ex vivo immunology studies using primary human and/or animal immune cells, whole blood, or tissue-based systems, with proficiency in multiparameter flow cytometry, cytokine/chemokine assays, and complementary functional or molecular readouts.

 - Ability to develop, troubleshoot, and document robust cell-based assay cascades using appropriate controls, counterscreens, and orthogonal readouts to confirm on-target activity and generate reproducible compound-profiling data; experience transferring assays to CROs or automated/HTS platforms is preferred.

 - Experience supporting small-molecule discovery through compound screening or profiling; exposure to hit identification, hit-to-lead, or lead optimization is preferred.

 - Working knowledge of in vivo immunology and pharmacology, including model selection, dosing, endpoints, tissue collection, PK/PD, and pharmacodynamic biomarkers; direct hands-on experience is a plus.

 - Demonstrated scientific rigor, sound experimental judgment, strong organization and communication, and enthusiasm for a collaborative, bench-focused role.



ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS 
Iambic Therapeutics (Nasdaq: IAM) is a technology and clinical-stage life sciences company headquartered in San Diego. By utilizing molecular superintelligence — integrating proprietary AI with automated, scalable chemistry and biology experimentation — our platform is designed to address the totality of drug discovery and development. At Iambic, we are building an engine that is designed to power the future of medicine. Learn more at iambic.ai http://iambic.ai. 

MISSION & VALUES 
Our mission is to make better technology for better medicines. Three values guide how we work: 

 - Bold. We are courageous, take thoughtful risks, and approach challenges with tenacity.

 - Innovative. We are creative and find new solutions that deliver impact.

 - Collaborative. We respect one another and partner with integrity. 

We value the range of perspectives our people bring, and we work to build an environment where every team member can contribute and grow. 

PAY AND BENEFITS 
The pay range for this role is listed above. Actual pay depends on factors including experience, skills, and location. Eligible employees in the U.S. receive company-paid medical coverage, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance, 401(k) matching and flexible time off. We are in a brand-new state-of-the art facility in beautiful San Diego with a community gym, dining, and easy access to great places to live and play. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 
Iambic is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
